senses.gloss_en: to weary, to tire, to fatigue
sphincter (band of muscle that surrounds an opening)
chafe (injury or wear caused by friction)
sore or open wound caused by chafing
affected by hunger; desirous of food
person with special interest in food
scrubbing (act or effect of rubbing; repeated passage of one surface over another, exerting pressure)
mop (utensil for cleaning the floor consisting of a handle with strips of cloth at the end)
